title.narrative: Start Ready Risk Pool 4 Zimbabwe Drought National Reserves -GRAAP Phase 1

description.narrative:
Overview The National Reserve Risk Pool 4 anticipatory action project - Phase 1- in Gwanda is a one month project aims to enhance disaster preparedness and response through a series of coordinated activities that engage local stakeholders, align disaster risk reduction plans, and build community capacity ahead of the anticipatory action project. The 1-month (September to October 2025) project focuses on fostering collaboration among stakeholders, ensuring that local needs and conditions are reflected in planning, and equipping the community with the necessary tools for effective data collection and analysis. Objectives
Facilitate an inception and stakeholder consultation meeting to ensure all parties understand the project scope and activities. Build strong relationships among stakeholders to encourage ongoing collaboration, even in the absence of immediate activation.
Conduct a rapid review of district and ward-based disaster risk reduction and anticipatory action plans to ensure alignment with community needs. Develop data collection tools for gender and disability analyses, borehole assessments, and distribution points to enhance the district’s capacity for the upcoming anticipatory action project
